description: Fast probes — minimum prompts to measure cold-gen tps + correctness.

items.prompt: List the first 7 prime numbers, comma separated. Reply with just one line: ANSWER: <numbers>

Write a 3-line Python function is_balanced(s) that returns True iff all (), [], {} are balanced and properly nested in s. Then state ANSWER: True if is_balanced('a(b[c]{d}e)f') is True, else ANSWER: False. Be concise.
Write exactly one paragraph (about 80 words) describing the architecture of a mixture-of-experts transformer. End with ANSWER: done
